text: The Customer must settle each invoice within thirty days of receipt.
Late payment under this agreement does not accrue any interest.
The Supplier's liability under this agreement is unlimited for all types of claims.
The agreement requires that all disputes be resolved by arbitration in Singapore.
Confidentiality obligations continue for five years after the agreement ends.
The Supplier must provide 24 hour, 7 day a week customer support.
The initial term of the agreement is twenty-four months.
Either party may terminate the agreement immediately for any reason without notice.
